items.title: Cabinet approves contract for 100 MWh battery storage system at Kolonnawa
items.summary: The Cabinet has approved a contract to develop Sri Lanka’s first utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at the Kolonnawa Grid Substation.
items.title_dv: ކޮލޮންވާގައި 100 މެގަވޮޓް ގަޑިއިރުގެ ބެޓެރީ ސްޓޯރޭޖް ސިސްޓަމެއް ގާއިމް ކުރުމަށް ކެބިނެޓުން ފާސްކޮށްފި އެވެ
items.summary_dv: ކޮލޮންނާވާ ގްރިޑް ސަބްސްޓޭޝަންގައި ރާއްޖޭގެ ފުރަތަމަ ޔުޓިލިޓީ ސްކޭލް ބެޓެރީ އެނާޖީ ސްޓޯރޭޖް ސިސްޓަމް (ބީއީއެސްއެސް) ތަރައްގީ ކުރުމުގެ އެއްބަސްވުމެއް ވަޒީރުންގެ މަޖިލީހުން ފާސްކޮށްފި އެވެ.

items.title: Rs. 1.09 billion contract awarded for Sampur-Kappalthurai power project
items.summary: The Cabinet has approved the award of a contract to develop electricity transmission infrastructure between Sampur and Kappalthurai at a cost of USD 4.15 million, EUR 780,000 and Rs. 1,096.08 million, excluding taxes.

items.title: Sri Lanka moves to ban cluster munitions
items.summary: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved a proposal to prepare draft legislation to prohibit cluster munitions in Sri Lanka, in line with the country’s obligations under the International Convention on Cluster Munitions.

items.title: Rs. 111 million contract awarded to supply 1.1 million bags of dialysis medicines
items.summary: The Cabinet has approved the award of a Rs. 111.1 million contract to supply 1.1 million bags of medicines used in the treatment of kidney patients undergoing haemodialysis.

items.title: Rs. 1.3 billion contract to upgrade three-kilometre Kandy-Jaffna road section in Vavuniya
